sources.beginner: hand-calc from the prompt's gun and sieve per src/content/courses/perfsand/beginner/m06-the-associate-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md; src/components/course/panels/perfsand/ShotExplorer.jsx Geometry view takes a custom spf and prints density/spacing to 6 decimals (:109-110), the Sieve view cannot load the capstone curve.
sources.intermediate: hand-calc (Karakas-Tariq) per src/content/courses/perfsand/intermediate/m06-the-professional-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md; no screen takes the capstone gun (SkinExplorer Components selects published guns only, :49; Suite PerforatingTab is catalog-only), and only alpha of the 90 deg constant row is printed (SkinExplorer.jsx:241), so s_v, s_wb and everything downstream lack their constants.
sources.advanced: band and gauge from src/components/course/panels/perfsand/SandExplorer.jsx Gravel view (typed D50, :116-125) or 5 x D50 by hand; the four sanding values need the golden profile at 2200-2320 m, but the Sanding view is locked to the published 2450-2550 m interval (perfsandLab.js:202-206), so they are unobtainable today.

fields.evidence: 8 spf/ft x 3.280839895 = 26.24671916 per m, a one-step conversion the lesson directs; the Geometry view also takes a custom spf (ShotExplorer.jsx:104) and prints fmt(spfPerFt*FT_PER_M, 6) = 26.246719, within tol 5e-7 of the expected.
Spacing = 0.3048/8 = 0.0381 m exactly; the Geometry view prints fmt(s.hM, 6) = 0.0381 with spf 8 entered.

Log interpolation between the 200 um (36) and 140 um (54) sieves of the prompt's curve, taught in m04 l04 and the capstone lesson (l02:19); the Sieve view only offers the published and rung sands (ShotExplorer.jsx:157), so the capstone curve is worked by hand at full precision.
Log interpolation between 400 um (7) and 280 um (19) on the retained curve; closed form from prompt inputs, full precision, tol 5e-10 m is 0.0005 um which a calculator easily meets.
D40/D90 from two more log interpolations of the prompt's curve (capstone lesson l02:21,37); no panel can load the capstone sieve, full precision by hand.
100 minus the retained percentage log-interpolated at 44 um between 50 um (92) and 38 um (96); lesson l02:23 directs the interpolation. tol 5e-6 fine for a hand value.

ln(rw/(alpha(rw+lp))) with rw = 9.875/2 in, lp = 22 in; alpha at 90 deg is printed as 0.726 in the Phasing table (fmt(r.alpha, 4)), which is the exact table value. Recomputed -1.3764549735 = expected.
fields.notes: No panel or Suite screen takes the capstone gun: SkinExplorer Components only selects the two published guns (SkinExplorer.jsx:49), ShotExplorer Geometry fixes the published 45 deg gun and rw 0.10795, and the Suite PerforatingTab picks catalog guns only.

fields.recommendation: Print the SPE 18247 constant table in the SkinExplorer Phasing view (only alpha is shown today). The alternative, letting the Components view take custom spf, lp, entrance hole, phasing, rw and rc, is a bigger change and turns the tier into a read-off.
fields.evidence: 10^(a1 log rpD + a2) hD^(b-1) rpD^b needs the 90 deg a1, a2, b1, b2 (-1.905, 0.1038, 1.5674, 1.6935, perforation.js:39); no lesson or panel prints them (grep of content/courses/perfsand and panels/perfsand finds none; the Phasing table shows alpha only) and no screen can be set to the capstone gun.
(h/lp) ln(rc/rp)(k/kc - 1) from prompt inputs, form taught in m02 l04; no constants. Recomputed 0.2579586583 = expected.

fields.evidence: ln(re/rw)/(ln(re/rw)+s) with re 220 m is a closed form, but s is skin_total, so it inherits the missing Karakas-Tariq constants; the Ratio view takes a typed skin (SkinExplorer.jsx:277) but only reports fixed re values (50..2000, not 220).
rp/(2h)(1+sqrt(kv/kh)) from prompt inputs, form taught in m02 l02; no constants. Recomputed 0.0798007365 = expected; tol 5e-8 fine at full precision.

5 x the Associate D50 (hand-calc, full precision), and the Saucier range '5 to 6' is printed (SandExplorer.jsx:127). The Gravel view band tile prints only 2 decimals of um (757.74) against tol 0.0005 um, but the lesson routes the learner through the hand value.

stripped.why: nothing printed its answers: re-measured, no lesson in any tier and no panel first render prints a graded Expert value (four of the five B5 leak flags came from a sentence saying the lessons print NO stress or strength numbers; the gauge margin is one of seven rows of the gauge table, and picking the row is the work), so the label was untrue

fields.evidence: Typing the capstone D50 into 'Or a D50 directly (um)' gives gravel 16/30, largest gauge 23.4252 thou, gauge 20 thou and 'Gauge margin 87.00 um' (fmt(pack.marginM/UM, 3)); expected 8.7e-5 m is exactly 87 um, tol 5e-10 m.
fields.notes: Possible LEAK: the Gravel view's default state (graded sand, also sized to 16/30) shows 'Gauge margin 87.00 um' (probe), and the always-visible gauge table prints every gravel's margin (SandExplorer.jsx:163), so the answer space is the 7 table margins. Picking the right row still needs the Saucier band, so left as none.
